items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment and approve no new spend, monetization expansion, or implementation admissions this cycle. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the full commission is unattributed, so site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and causal lift are unsupported. AI usage cost is $997.52 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 across 5,522 calls, including 234 errors and 5 transient errors. The apparent 203x cost-to-commission comparison is not an ROI calculation because periods and attribution boundaries differ. Infrastructure, fixed, and marketing costs are absent; monthly spend limits are blank, so budget exposure cannot be bounded. Keep the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA request slot-gated after the saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case releases capacity; measure registered affiliate clicks only and make no revenue claim.

Do not admit new finance-sensitive implementation or site-factory work while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. Preserve the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close gate and the queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA request only. Any future affiliate work must retain registered site tracking IDs and must not allocate aggregate provider revenue to a site.

Reject the proposed three-site site-factory admissions this cycle. They have no current revenue evidence, analytics is not configured for those scaffold sites, launch readiness is incomplete, and capacity is saturated. Retain them only as deferred operational candidates without forecast revenue or budget approval.
